page.layout: One printed page: running text in one column, with marginal numbers 394, 389, 390 at the right edge and a catchword "Con-" at the lower right. Running head at top right.
page.running_head: Gratianus, Valentin, II, Theod. Lib. III.

main_text.p: Aulæ Magiftrum, Imperatorem dixiffet, In eo Eugenius cum Arbogaste Mediolano egreffus, ubi Iurejurando affirmârat, fe victoriâ partâ ftabu- lum in bafilica Mediolanenfi facturum, Clauftra Alpium infedit, & caftra ad fluvium frigidum po- fuit, Theodofius, milite ex Romanis, Gothis & Hunnis confcripto, & præfidio dejecto, duplex prælium commifit. Primo XM ex Gothis cecidé- re, & Ducesin fequens ver bellum differri fuade- bant. Altero, Theodofio per fomnium alacri, in- genti vento, qui & arma hoftibus excutiebat, cor- tes aliquot ad Theodofium tranfivére, Eugenius captus & capite truncatus eft; Arbogaftes mortem fibi confcivit; Victoria eâ ipsâ horâ Con- ftantinopoli à Dæmoniaco nunciata eft. Ethæc de bellis Theodofii. Seditionum primam Antio- 389 cheni ob novum tributum motêre, & Imperato- ris ftatuæ dejectæ in luto trahebantur: alteram 390 Theffalonicenses, quod præfectus aurigam adul- terum, quo nemo in ludis adminiftrandis peritior, in carcerem injeciffet. Inca præfectus cum ali- quot nobilibus trucidatus eft. Diverfus utriusque exitus. Antiochenis, per Florianum Epifcopum iram deprecantibus, venia data. Theffalonicæ ita in vulgus fævitum, ut trium horarum fpatio ad VIIM perierint. Theodofius ab Ambrofio mo- nitus, & pœnitentiâ ductus, ut non nifi poft tri- gefimum diem à lata fententia rei extremo fup- plicio afficerentur, fanxit. Mortuus eft aqua intercute, poftquam annos XVI, dies duos impe- raffet. Confobrinorum nuptias, tanquam minus honeftas, lege prohibuit.

page.notes: Marginal numbers 394 (beside first lines of the first paragraph), 389 and 390 as printed. Page is a torn, low-contrast scan; the right edge is cut, and some words near the binding (e.g. "Eugenius", "Clauftra") may be imperfect. Printed marginal "Con-" is a catchword at lower right. Show-through and stains omitted.
